description: Strict sub-line and variant guardrails to prevent false matches between sister product lines and pack multipliers.

brand_subline_rules.rule: Never match Breathe to Energy or Sprint, even if flavor and pack size are identical.
Never match Whey Rulz Plus with Iso Rulz or Whey Rulz Ripped.
Never cross-match Pre Rulz base with Shred or RDX variants.
Never bind Critical Whey to Clear Whey or Critical Plant.

pack_multiplier_rules.enforcement: NEVER match a bulk pack/box listing to a single sachet/can/bar POS SKU without an explicit POS bundle code.
